Added 'storageType' field to match the web module's ImageProcessingMessage contract and enable backend service routing based on storage type.

Configuration bean properly creates and returns a private BlobContainerClient used by both the dev profile (BlobFileStorageService) and the non-dev profile (AzureBlobService). Uses managed identity for authentication (passwordless). Gracefully handles scenarios where the managed identity may have read-only Blob Data permissions without container management rights. Comment correctly documents that both profiles share this container to avoid duplicate provisioning.

New non-dev/object-storage-profile service replacing the previous AWS S3-backed AwsS3Service. Implements StorageService interface and provides all required operations: listObjects, uploadObject, getObject, deleteObject. Key strengths: (1) Uses BlobKeyValidator to sanitize caller-supplied filenames and keys, closing CWE-99/CWE-22/CWE-23/CWE-36 vulnerabilities. (2) Validates filename before concatenating with UUID prefix, preventing sophisticated path-traversal attacks. (3) Publishes ImageProcessingMessage with storageType='azure-blob' for thumbnail routing. (4) Creates and maintains ImageMetadata database rows, preserving the non-dev profile's metadata write behavior verified in Phase 1 baseline. (5) Falls back to blob's lastModified when metadata is not found during list operations. (6) Tolerates thumbnail deletion failures gracefully (best-effort deletion matching previous S3 behavior). (7) Uses content-type headers appropriately. (8) Never exposes SAS URLs; bytes are always streamed through the application's S3Controller.

Utility class for validating and normalizing blob keys before storage access, mitigating CWE-22, CWE-23, CWE-36, and CWE-99. Properly sanitizes caller-supplied filenames and keys by: (1) Rejecting blank/null keys; (2) Using Spring's cleanPath to normalize; (3) Rejecting any key containing '..'; (4) Detecting and rejecting absolute paths (Unix-style leading slash, Windows drive letters, UNC shares). Critically, it sanitizes the raw filename BEFORE concatenation with UUID prefix, preventing sophisticated path-traversal attacks where ../../secret.jpg could be collapsed after prefixing to defeat post-concatenation checks.

New non-dev/object-storage-profile thumbnail processing service replacing the previous AWS S3-backed S3FileProcessingService. Extends AbstractFileProcessingService and provides downloadOriginal and uploadThumbnail operations. Key strengths: (1) Uses BlobKeyValidator to sanitize all keys (both original and thumbnail keys), closing CWE-99/CWE-22/CWE-23/CWE-36 vulnerabilities. (2) Reports storageType='azure-blob' matching AzureBlobService for message routing. (3) Properly extracts original key from thumbnail key using _thumbnail suffix logic, then updates matching ImageMetadata row with thumbnail key/URL. (4) Generates app-relative URLs (/storage/key) rather than SAS URLs, consistent with dev profile behavior and BlobFileProcessingService. (5) Tolerates missing original metadata rows gracefully (no-op if no match found). (6) Sets content-type headers appropriately.

Utility class for validating and normalizing blob keys before storage access, identical implementation to the web module's version, mitigating CWE-22, CWE-23, CWE-36, and CWE-99. Properly sanitizes caller-supplied keys and prevents path-traversal attacks.

Comprehensive unit tests for AzureBlobService covering all public methods and edge cases. All Azure Blob Storage, Service Bus, and database interactions are properly mocked. Test coverage includes: (1) Upload success path with metadata creation and message publishing; (2) Duplicate uploads creating independent messages and rows; (3) Empty file rejection; (4) Path-traversal filename rejection; (5) BlobStorageException wrapping; (6) Get object success/not-found paths; (7) Path-traversal key rejection on get; (8) Delete with original/thumbnail/metadata removal; (9) Delete leaving unrelated metadata untouched; (10) Thumbnail deletion failure tolerance; (11) Path-traversal key rejection on delete; (12) List operation resolving uploadedAt from metadata; (13) List fallback to lastModified; (14) List exception handling; (15) StorageType reporting. No live services contacted.

Comprehensive unit tests for BlobKeyValidator covering all validation rules. Tests confirm: (1) Simple filenames accepted; (2) Nested path keys accepted; (3) Blank/null keys rejected; (4) Relative path traversal patterns rejected (../, ../../etc/passwd, sub/../../secret, etc.); (5) Absolute path traversal patterns rejected (Unix-style, Windows drive letters, UNC shares). Validation is thorough and correctly addresses CWE-22, CWE-23, and CWE-36.

Comprehensive unit tests for AzureBlobFileProcessingService covering all public methods and edge cases. All Azure Blob Storage and database interactions are properly mocked. Test coverage includes: (1) StorageType reporting; (2) Download original success path; (3) Download original not-found exception; (4) Download original path-traversal rejection; (5) Upload thumbnail with file, content-type, and metadata update; (6) Upload thumbnail with no matching metadata (graceful no-op); (7) Upload thumbnail path-traversal rejection; (8) URL generation confirming app-relative path (no SAS); (9) Extract original key logic for _thumbnail suffix stripping. No live services contacted.

Comprehensive unit tests for BlobKeyValidator covering all validation rules, identical to the web module's version. Tests confirm proper validation of blob keys and rejection of path-traversal patterns.
